versions.changelog:
Initial release of the professional-communication skill.

- Provides ready-to-use templates and guides for emails, Slack/Teams messages, meeting agendas, and status updates.
- Includes guidelines for translating technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
- Emphasizes clear, scannable messaging with actionable requests.
- Routes users to references for email templates, jargon simplification, meeting structures, and remote communication best practices.
- Outlines four core rules and common pitfalls to avoid in professional communication.
